items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Billy Berg didn't have to do nothing. He just called up down there and told them he wanted me to come in

ctx.x: Yeah, it cleared the way. Well, Billy Berg didn't have to do nothing. He just called up down there and told them he wanted me to come in, and they said "Okay" to him, but they told me, no, you couldn't do this.
